tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Base page background, and editable, image or placeholder areas where a tint would reduce readability.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Default body text and headings on `surface` and any T tint — the standard dark-text colour under the H/S/T contrast rule.

tokens.name: on-dark
tokens.usage: Text and icons on dark fills: `h1-jazzberry`, `h7-bondi-blue`, `h8-denim`, `h9-twilight` and every S colour. Every other H fill (h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, h10) takes `ink` instead.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Hyperlinks and interactive text on `surface` or any T tint except `t9-periwinkle` (use `link-on-t9` there). Underline links so they aren't signalled by colour alone.

tokens.name: link-on-t9
tokens.usage: Hyperlinks on `t9-periwinkle` (11.5:1), underlined — `h8-denim` fails on that tint (4.4:1).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus rings and input borders on `surface` or any T tint.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Lato Black, 133pt in the source spec (≈177px). Slide/deck titles and the cover name treatment.

styles.name: subtitle
styles.usage: Lato Light, 57pt (≈76px). Deck subtitles, under a `title`.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Lato Bold, 57pt (≈76px). Slide headings — same size as `subtitle`, bold instead of light to read as a heading, not a subtitle.

styles.name: section-header
styles.usage: Lato Bold, 28pt (≈37px). Section/card headers within a slide.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Lato Light, 26pt (≈35px). Default slide body copy.

styles.name: quote
styles.usage: Lato Light, 26pt (≈35px), italic. Same size as `body` — set in italics to read as a quote panel.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Lato Light, 16pt (≈21px). Captions and small print.
